senses.gloss: m. (supposed to be a comp. of סָס a. מגיר, cmp. מְגֵרָה) [a sawing worm,] name of a species of cedar subject to decay.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 9b:16">Yoma 9ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>מאי ארז שהרקב שולט בו ס׳ …</he> what is the cedar over which decay has power?… Sasmagor (Ms. L. omits our w., and has only the explanation of it: <he>ארז מגור מן הסס</he>, v. <cite ref="O01270"><he>סָס</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200). [To the following <he>מאי ס׳</he> what is S.?, the reply <he>ארז מגור מן הסס</he> has obviously fallen out, whereas the subsequent <he>אמר ר׳ אבא בת קול</he> resumes the discussion interrupted by <he>מאי ארז וכ׳</he>;—different in comment.]
